name: squareline-design-tools
description: Node dependencies of the squareline-design toolkit: SVG->PNG (resvg + lucide icons) and LVGL font conversion (lv_font_conv). Installed per machine by `python3 tools/slx.py setup` (npm ci).
//: Do NOT commit or copy node_modules between machines: @resvg ships one native binding per platform and npm installs only the one for the CURRENT machine (resvg-wasm is the portable fallback). Run `python3 tools/slx.py setup`.
